objective: Find and independently verify a marked robust upgrade over the existing ExtraTrees/Ridge/HGB fixture benchmark. A completed campaign with no improvement does not complete this goal.
user_correction: Previous simulator evaluation was a foundation; user intended continued testing until a marked improvement.

departments.evaluation: evaluation_design: prospective campaign budgets, comparisons, thresholds and independent validation
departments.engine: game_engine: controlled solver and matched repeatability probes
departments.models: swarm_design: current-origin fixture trajectories and participation/point model candidates
departments.data: data_readiness: timestamped feature availability and upcoming-fixture coverage

write_policy: New derived work only in this directory; sources and previous phase are read-only. Preserve every attempted experiment and failure.
next_gates: Freeze campaign protocol and finite candidate list before new comparative outcomes
Validate cheap solver repeatability and causal feature/forecast smoke probes
Run first bounded development campaign with a freshly matched benchmark
If no robust marked upgrade, diagnose and continue a new recorded hypothesis campaign; do not mark goal complete

winning_score_context.interpretation: 2600–2700 is not a universal winning threshold, and modern-rule counterfactual scores are not directly comparable to historical official winning totals.
